channel.title: Zodiacs — The Archive
channel.description: Dated moments, press, and origin records for the twelve Zodiacs: the accidental Libra, the astrology girlies, and a register that verified itself in public.

item.title: A pure belief system
item.description: CZ describes gold as a pure belief system. The thesis applies the same lens to symbols that outlast the institutions around them.

item.title: The accidental Libra
item.description: During the collapse of an unrelated token called LIBRA, Dave Portnoy bought the official Zodiac Libra by mistake, posted its mint verbatim to millions, and the record verified itself in public.

item.title: A nod from inversebrah
item.description: The most-watched lurker on crypto X turns its attention to the zodiac, in the signature shorthand.

item.title: Twelve hundred first wallets
item.description: An Astrofolio airdrop run with iJaadee brings more than 1,200 women onchain, most of them to their first Solana wallet.

item.title: The astrology girlies arrive
item.description: iJaadee, an astrology voice with a six-figure following, calls her community into the twelve coins.

item.title: Human civilization’s oldest meme
item.description: Andrew Kang of Mechanism Capital frames astrology as the longest-running meme in human history.

item.title: The astrologers have arrived
item.description: TikTokInvestors, the account that catalogues retail’s arrival in every cycle, files the zodiac moment early.

item.title: Horoscopes to HODL
item.description: Numinous Realm publishes a long-form profile: an interview with the founder on fair distribution, BRC-20 origins, and what makes a perfect Lindy meme.

item.title: Twelve mints, one register
item.description: The twelve Zodiacs are minted on Solana and fully distributed. No presale, no allocation, a public record from the first day.
